biography.value: Blade Aetherim are the first Aetherim capable of functioning as a primary combatant rather than a support presence. Holy Blade's destruction of low-HP undead at Margin 3 makes them highly effective in encounters involving significant undead threats. Turn Undead clears the engagement zone of undead entirely in many cases, allowing other combatants to focus on non-undead threats. A summoner who calls one into an undead-heavy encounter will find it efficiently handles that specific problem while maintaining Protective Aura support for allies. Against living opponents it is capable but not exceptional — capable enough to hold its own, not so effective that a summoner should expect it to carry the fight.

system.attacksNotes:
Holy Blade [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 3), Reach: 5 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 9 damage (5 + 4 Str) + 3 Positive damage (Half DR).
  • Margin 2: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; undead and evil-aligned creatures Frightened for 1 minute; Will [Easy] save to resist.
  • Margin 3: 9 damage, DR halved (round up) + 3 Positive damage; Frightened; no save; undead must make Fortitude [Easy] saveor destroyed outright if below half HP.

Radiant Arc [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 3 + Ranged Combat 2), Range: 60 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 11 Positive damage (8 + 3 Dex); target Dazzled until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 2: 11 Positive damage, DR halved (round up) + Blinded until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 11 Positive damage, DR halved (round up) + Blinded + Revealed for 1 minute.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Healing Touch (3/short rest): Restores 10 HP per use. Can now stabilize dying creatures automatically with a touch as a [Minor] action. Protective Aura: Allies within 20 feet of the Blade Aetherim gain +2 DR against all damage. This aura is always active. Turn Undead (1/encounter) [Combat]: As a [Combat] action, releases a pulse of Positive energy in a 30-foot diameter. All undead in range make a Will save (opposed by Wis 5 + Religion 4). On failure, undead are Frightened and must move away from the Blade Aetherim as fast as possible for 1 minute. They cannot willingly move closer for the duration. Detect Evil: Automatically senses creatures with actively malicious intent within 60 feet and communicates their general direction and distance to the summoner as a [Free] action each round. Continual Radiance: Sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. The Shield Aetherim cannot suppress this light voluntarily.
